title: VWAP/ATR Mean-Reversion Research Template
hypothesis: In a balanced, liquid range, an unusually large 15-minute displacement from session VWAP may revert after momentum stops extending, net of all trading costs.

required_data.freshness: no older than the execution-latency assumption

required_data.field: funding rate and next payment timestamp

parameters.vwap_session: venue UTC trading day; test alternative anchors separately

long: The 1h and 4h context is classified as trend.range, not an established downtrend.
The last closed 15m price is at least the tested ATR displacement below session VWAP.
The stochastic reading stops making a new low while price remains displaced.
Liquidity is not thin or dislocated and estimated round-trip cost is below the configured cap.
short: The 1h and 4h context is classified as trend.range, not an established uptrend.
The last closed 15m price is at least the tested ATR displacement above session VWAP.
The stochastic reading stops making a new high while price remains displaced.
Liquidity is not thin or dislocated and estimated round-trip cost is below the configured cap.

invalidation: The higher-timeframe range breaks and holds beyond its defined boundary.
A volatility shock, liquidity dislocation, or liquidation cascade is detected.
Price extends another configured ATR distance without the required momentum stall.
exit_logic: Test partial or full exit at session VWAP; do not assume a touch is fillable.
Exit at the predeclared volatility stop or when structural invalidation occurs.
Apply a time exit at the configured maximum holding bars.
Accrue funding if the position crosses a venue payment timestamp.

cost_model.notes: Use venue- and order-type-specific costs at each historical timestamp; reject zero-slippage fills and include adverse selection for resting limits.

rules: Position size is derived from the caller's risk budget and simulated stop distance; the playbook supplies no default risk percentage.
Cap size by executable depth and maintenance-margin headroom.
Do not average down after invalidation or increase leverage to recover losses.

failure_modes: A genuine breakout or cascade looks statistically stretched and continues instead of reverting.
VWAP differs across venues and the chosen session boundary can manufacture apparent displacement.
Limit-order backtests overstate fills by ignoring queue position and adverse selection.
Costs consume the small reversion distance.
validation_plan: Freeze the parameter grid and test chronologically with non-overlapping walk-forward windows.
Report results separately by all four regime dimensions, venue, direction, and funding sign.
Use an execution simulator with spread, depth, partial fills, latency, fees, impact, and funding.
Retain a final untouched period and report uncertainty, trade count, drawdown, and after-cost expectancy.
warning: Untested research hypothesis. Not financial advice, a recommendation, or evidence of profitability.
